data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘khurama’, meaning 'to be little'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes humility and reverence towards Allah. The name Khurmi carries the meaning “A little one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khurmi usually hope their child will grow to embody a little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Khurmi" lies in its connection to humility, a cardinal virtue in Islam. As such, the name serves as a constant reminder for the individual to remain humble and mindful of their standing before Allah.
